title: Micro-Manager light managerProperties
description: One Micro-Manager light source presented as an ImSwitch2 laser. 'label' is the device that switches emission, and 'enable' says how: a Shutter device, a State device position, or a property that takes one of two values. Without 'power' the light is binary (an on/off switch). With 'power' a numeric property sets the output: the laser entry's valueRangeMin/valueRangeMax must then be numbers inside the property's Micro-Manager limits, and 'units' and 'decimals' are required because Micro-Manager properties carry neither. The laser entry's 'wavelength' is required by ImSwitch2 itself. No scan gating (there is no TTL path) and no modulation. System-config mode: 'label' names a device the hub's .cfg loaded. Inline mode: 'adapter' and 'device' make the manager load the device itself under 'label' (and unload it when it finalizes).

rs232device.description: Name of the 'micromanager.core' entry in rs232devices that owns the MMCore this light lives in.

label.description: Micro-Manager label of the device that switches emission. System-config mode: a device the hub's .cfg loaded (a typo is reported with the list of loaded devices of the type 'enable.kind' needs). Inline mode: the label the new device gets.

adapter.description: Inline mode: Micro-Manager device adapter library (for example 'DemoCamera'). Must be given together with 'device'; leave both out when the .cfg already loads the label.

device.description: Inline mode: device name inside the adapter (for example 'DShutter'). Must be given together with 'adapter'.

parent.description: Inline mode: label of the hub device (Micro-Manager Hub) the device hangs off, when the adapter needs one.

preInitProperties.description: Inline mode: properties that can only be set before the device is initialised (Micro-Manager 'pre-init' properties), applied in order before initialisation.

enable.description: How emission is switched on 'label'. Every switch is read back from the device; a device that does not show the new state is a failed command. Emission is switched off (and verified) after a transport reconnect and when the manager finalizes.

kind.description: 'label' is a Micro-Manager Shutter device; on opens it (setShutterOpen true), off closes it.
'label' is a Micro-Manager State device (filter wheel, LED selector ...); on and off are two of its positions.

on.description: The state position that emits: a state label (string, for example '470nm') or a state index (integer). A label or index the device does not have is refused at startup with the device's state labels.

off.description: The state position that is dark: a state label (for example 'Closed') or a state index. Must differ from 'on'.

kind.description: A property of 'label' takes one value for emission and another for dark.

name.description: The property to write. Must exist, must not be read-only.

on.description: The property value that emits. When the property lists allowed values, it must be one of them (numbers compare by value, so 1 matches '1').

off.description: The property value that is dark. Must differ from 'on'.

power.description: Optional output power. The light is binary when this block is absent. The laser entry's valueRangeMin and valueRangeMax (numbers, min < max) are the safe range of the property in 'units'; when Micro-Manager states limits for the property, that range must lie inside them, and a value outside the range is refused even where Micro-Manager would take it. Writing power does not switch emission: they are separate switches.

label.description: Device that has the power property. Default: the same device as 'label' above. A different device must be loaded by the hub's .cfg (inline mode loads only 'label').

property.description: Numeric (float or integer) Micro-Manager property that sets the output; must exist and must not be read-only.

units.description: Unit of the power value, shown in the laser widget (for example 'mW', 'V' or '%'). Required: Micro-Manager properties carry no unit and the bridge does not guess one.

decimals.description: How many decimals the power value has; the value is written to Micro-Manager with exactly this many. Required: Micro-Manager properties carry no precision. Must be 0 for an integer property.
